request.project_task: Build a travel expense submission and approval workflow.
request.project_goal: Reduce manual checking of employee expense claims.
request.project_description: An employee submits receipts; a manager reviews policy exceptions and finance reimburses approved claims.

functional_requirements.text: An employee creates an expense claim with trip details.

atoms.text: An employee creates an expense claim with trip details.

functional_requirements.text: The employee attaches receipts to expense items.

atoms.text: The employee attaches receipts to expense items.

functional_requirements.text: The system flags items above policy limits.

atoms.text: The system flags items above policy limits.

functional_requirements.text: A manager approves or rejects the claim.

atoms.text: A manager approves or rejects the claim.

functional_requirements.text: Finance records reimbursement for an approved claim.

atoms.text: Finance records reimbursement for an approved claim.

non_functional_requirements.text: Receipt files must be encrypted at rest.
All approval decisions must be auditable.

actors.name: Employee
actors.description: A staff member who incurs travel expenses and submits claims for reimbursement.

actors.name: Manager
actors.description: A line manager who reviews and approves or rejects employee expense claims.

actors.name: Finance Officer
actors.description: A finance team member who records reimbursement for approved claims.

actors.name: Policy Engine
actors.description: System component that evaluates expense items against policy limits and flags exceptions.

use_cases.name: Submit Travel Expense Claim
use_cases.goal: Employee creates and submits a travel expense claim with trip details and attached receipts so that it can be reviewed for reimbursement.
use_cases.trigger: Employee decides to claim reimbursement for travel expenses incurred.

preconditions.text: Employee is authenticated and authorized to create expense claims.
Employee has trip details and receipt files available.

success_postconditions.text: Expense claim is created with trip details and expense items.
Receipts are attached to expense items and stored encrypted at rest.
Items exceeding policy limits are flagged for manager review.
Claim is submitted and routed to the manager for approval.

failure_postconditions.text: Claim is not submitted; employee is informed of the validation or upload error.

main_success_scenario.name: Employee submits a compliant expense claim

steps.action: Employee starts a new expense claim and enters trip details.
steps.expected_result: System creates a draft claim with the provided trip details.

steps.action: Employee adds expense items and attaches receipt files to each item.
steps.expected_result: Receipts are uploaded, associated with the expense items, and stored encrypted at rest.

steps.action: System evaluates each expense item against policy limits.
steps.expected_result: Items above policy limits are flagged; compliant items are not flagged.

steps.action: Employee reviews the claim summary and submits the claim.
steps.expected_result: Claim is submitted and routed to the manager for approval.

alternative_scenarios.name: Employee saves claim as draft before submitting

steps.action: Employee saves the partially completed claim as a draft.
steps.expected_result: Claim is saved in draft state and can be resumed later.

steps.action: Employee attempts to attach a receipt file that fails validation or upload.
steps.expected_result: System rejects the file, displays an error, and does not attach the receipt.

user_stories.capability: create an expense claim with trip details and attach receipts
user_stories.benefit: I can submit my travel expenses for reimbursement without manual paperwork.

system_stories.system_action: Store uploaded receipt files encrypted at rest.
system_stories.responsibility: Ensure receipt confidentiality and compliance with security requirements.

system_stories.system_action: Evaluate expense items against policy limits and flag exceptions.
system_stories.responsibility: Automatically detect policy violations to reduce manual checking.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-001 — Submit Travel Expense Claim
Goal: Employee creates and submits a travel expense claim with trip details and attached receipts so that it can be reviewed for reimbursement.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: Employee decides to claim reimbursement for travel expenses incurred.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC001-001: Employee is authenticated and authorized to create expense claims.
  - PRE-UC001-002: Employee has trip details and receipt files available.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC001-001] Employee starts a new expense claim and enters trip details.
  2. [STEP-UC001-002] Employee adds expense items and attaches receipt files to each item.
  3. [STEP-UC001-003] System evaluates each expense item against policy limits.
  4. [STEP-UC001-004] Employee reviews the claim summary and submits the claim.
Alternative scenarios:
  - SCN-UC001-ALT-001: Employee saves claim as draft before submitting
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC001-EXC-001: Receipt upload fails
Source FRs: FR-001, FR-002, FR-003

use_cases.name: Review and Decide Expense Claim
use_cases.goal: Manager reviews a submitted expense claim, including flagged policy exceptions, and approves or rejects it.
use_cases.trigger: A submitted expense claim is routed to the manager for approval.

preconditions.text: Manager is authenticated and authorized to approve claims.
A submitted expense claim is pending review.

success_postconditions.text: Claim is approved or rejected with a recorded decision.
Approval decision is recorded in an auditable log.

failure_postconditions.text: Decision is not recorded; manager is informed of the error.

main_success_scenario.name: Manager approves a claim with flagged exceptions

steps.action: Manager opens the pending expense claim and reviews trip details, expense items, receipts, and flagged policy exceptions.
steps.expected_result: Claim details and flagged items are displayed.
Claim status is set to approved and the decision is recorded in an auditable log.

steps.action: Manager rejects the claim and provides a reason.
steps.expected_result: Claim status is set to rejected and the decision with reason is recorded in an auditable log.

user_stories.capability: review flagged expense items and approve or reject a claim
user_stories.benefit: I can enforce travel policy while processing claims efficiently.

system_stories.system_action: Record every approval or rejection decision in an immutable audit log.
system_stories.responsibility: Provide auditable approval decisions for compliance.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-002 — Review and Decide Expense Claim
Goal: Manager reviews a submitted expense claim, including flagged policy exceptions, and approves or rejects it.
Primary actor: ACT-002
Trigger: A submitted expense claim is routed to the manager for approval.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC002-001: Manager is authenticated and authorized to approve claims.
  - PRE-UC002-002: A submitted expense claim is pending review.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC002-001] Manager opens the pending expense claim and reviews trip details, expense items, receipts, and flagged policy exceptions.
  2. [STEP-UC002-002] Manager approves the claim.
Alternative scenarios:
  - SCN-UC002-ALT-001: Manager rejects the claim
Source FRs: FR-004

use_cases.name: Record Reimbursement for Approved Claim
use_cases.goal: Finance records reimbursement for an approved expense claim so the employee is paid back.
use_cases.trigger: An expense claim has been approved by the manager.

preconditions.text: Finance officer is authenticated and authorized to record reimbursements.
An expense claim is in approved status.

success_postconditions.text: Reimbursement is recorded against the approved claim.
Claim status is updated to reimbursed.

failure_postconditions.text: Reimbursement is not recorded; finance officer is informed of the error.

main_success_scenario.name: Finance records reimbursement for an approved claim

steps.action: Finance officer opens the approved claim and initiates reimbursement recording.
steps.expected_result: Approved claim details are displayed and reimbursement entry is available.

steps.action: Finance officer records the reimbursement amount and payment reference.
steps.expected_result: Reimbursement is recorded and claim status is updated to reimbursed.

user_stories.capability: record reimbursement for an approved claim
user_stories.benefit: I can ensure employees are paid back accurately and the claim is closed.

system_stories.system_action: Update claim status to reimbursed after reimbursement is recorded.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-003 — Record Reimbursement for Approved Claim
Goal: Finance records reimbursement for an approved expense claim so the employee is paid back.
Primary actor: ACT-003
Trigger: An expense claim has been approved by the manager.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC003-001: Finance officer is authenticated and authorized to record reimbursements.
  - PRE-UC003-002: An expense claim is in approved status.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC003-001] Finance officer opens the approved claim and initiates reimbursement recording.
  2. [STEP-UC003-002] Finance officer records the reimbursement amount and payment reference.
Source FRs: FR-005

issues.message: Edge ADE-UC001-001 must link to UC step(s) or be marked unsupported

The exception action 'System rejects the file, displays an error, and does not attach the receipt.' is placed in the Employee partition, but the action is performed by the System. This is a non-blocking partition/layout issue and does not omit or contradict any UC step.

The alternative scenario 'Employee saves claim as draft before submitting' is modeled as a terminal 'Claim saved as draft' final node rather than rejoining the main flow at STEP-UC001-004. This is an equivalent control-flow decomposition and does not omit or contradict the UC step.

details.summary: The activity diagram preserves the main success scenario, the draft alternative, and the receipt-upload exception without unsupported business actions or step-level omissions. Only non-blocking partition/layout and control-flow decomposition warnings remain.
